Name: Seasonal Hats (Content Patcher)
Author: KaileyStardew
Description:
Adds [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2855]Seasonal Hats[/url] via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], without replacing any base-game hats.
This mod is an alternative to the original JSON Assets version of Seasonal Hats, as requested by community members. As I cannot directly update the original mod, this also serves as a backup in case the original ever breaks. 

Made with permission from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/53858471]Beans[/url].
